dialogues.speaker: Sosi
dialogues.text: ...Oh! It's you, Lady Sorush's Yasnapati. If you have any questions at all, I'll make sure to tell you everything I know.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: As you may have noticed, I haven't given up on investigating the Order of Skeptics' documents.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Although there had been some discrepancies between the records and the apparent situation...

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: I believe that as long as I look closely enough, the truth will emerge sooner or later.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Thanks to you all, Markozov has already withdrawn his troops.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: However, the Fatui would never give up that easily...

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: Perhaps it's time for the Order of Skeptics to recruit more capable personnel. At the very least, they should do better than Pyrrho.

response.speaker: Sosi
response.text: You're too kind. I'll be continuing with my work then.
